notes.title: Inbetween Land - Achievements Updated
notes.content:
Today we release the update that should fix all the problems with achievements our players faced with.

What's new:

More familiar and recognizable Facebook button in the main menu, now you won't miss it and the appropriate achievement Get Social will be yours;
We removed the Back 2 School achievement, so players can get all the rewards on any difficulty (in Expert mode this achievement was impossible to obtain);
Perfect Game reward is achievable, all you need is not to use Hint during the game.


Players who have faced with similar problems and do not want to play the game again, please contact us via the contact form on our website and we will help you.

Thank you all and have an excellent travel through the Inbetween Land.
